# Brazilian Hub Reporting

Brazilian Hub Reporting (32 pages): Brazilian Hub Reporting

## Chapters
- [Brazilian Hub Reporting](article_159680641660.md): Note: To access the Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp documentation in Brazilian Portuguese (Português do Brasil), see Brazilian Hub Reporting(https://system.
  - [Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp Installation](article_159680647481.md): This topic guides you through the installation of the Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp (BRHub Reporting).
  - [Roles and Permissions for Brazilian Hub Reporting](article_159681020937.md): Access to Brazilian Hub Reporting (BRHub Reporting) features requires several specific permissions.
  - [Fiscal Reports for Brazil (Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp)](article_160684281426.md): Fiscal reports enable Brazilian businesses to view and retrieve fiscal information from transactions recorded in NetSuite.
  - [Statutory Reports for Brazil (Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp)](article_159836471589.md): The Brazilian Hub Reporting SuiteApp enables you to issue specific types of reports to federal tax authorities, considering revenues, tax retentions, contributions, and tax returns.
